unsupported_claims: Uses biased second-order random walks with parameters p (return) and q (in-out) interpolating between BFS and DFS
Feeds sampled walks into a skip-gram/word2vec style objective
rationale: The core claims (learning low-dimensional embeddings, maximizing likelihood of preserving network neighborhoods, SGD optimization) are supported by the evidence. The specifics of biased second-order walks with p and q, the skip-gram objective, and negative sampling are not in the provided evidence, though BFS/DFS appears only in a figure caption, and they are accurate to the actual paper.
